name: portable-device-readiness-workload
purpose: Exercise language, speech, vision, specialist and memory-edge movement without making model-quality claims.

provenance.license_status: no external model or dataset license applies; generator and contract are governed by this repository's LICENSE
provenance.real_application_acceptance: UNAVAILABLE; no real audio, image, prompt or application fixture was supplied

sidecars.status: none required for the frozen transport fixture
sidecars.missing_input: UNAVAILABLE; no model-specific tokenizer, feature, prompt, label or serving sidecar was supplied

compatibility.parser: lmsluice safetensors-compatible parser and lmsluice archive reader
compatibility.runtime: Python standard library plus the repository source; stdlib-coded availability is conditional on compression.zstd or zstandard
compatibility.transport_only_meaning: successful byte movement and hash preservation do not constitute a real consumer

real_consumers.language: UNAVAILABLE; no tokenizer or language runtime fixture
real_consumers.speech_in_asr: UNAVAILABLE; no audio waveform, feature extractor or ASR runtime fixture
real_consumers.speech_out_tts: UNAVAILABLE; no text/audio acceptance fixture or TTS runtime fixture
real_consumers.vision: UNAVAILABLE; no image preprocessing or vision runtime fixture
real_consumers.specialist: UNAVAILABLE; no application task or specialist runtime fixture

availability_policy.plain: always generate and test when Python and repository source are available
availability_policy.stdlib_coded: generate and test when the configured interpreter exposes compression.zstd or zstandard; otherwise retain an explicit NOT_RUN/SKIP reason
availability_policy.lmz_coded: optional capability only when importable in the already configured interpreter; never install, search sibling checkouts or substitute its evidence
availability_policy.real_target: UNAVAILABLE unless an approved device, host, link and workload are supplied

input_output_contract.generated_input: deterministic hash stream keyed by fixture version, seed, role label and counter; BF16-like roles additionally use a fixed exponent-band transform
input_output_contract.output_equivalence_method: SHA-256 of the exact consumer-visible tensor bytes in file order; route output must match the frozen expected digest

evidence_classes.synthetic_transport: local deterministic bytes prove movement, integrity and bounded resource mechanics only
evidence_classes.simulated_constraint: local limiter, fault injector or loopback server; proxy evidence, not a device/WAN result
evidence_classes.optional_backend: capability result from an already configured interpreter; NOT_RUN is retained when absent
evidence_classes.customer_or_affordability: UNAVAILABLE/INCONCLUSIVE without approved host, power, thermal, cost, volume or customer evidence

coded_artifact.sha256_policy: per-run only: the archive records measured codec metadata and therefore its container hash is machine/run dependent
coded_artifact.unavailable_policy: record SKIP with the backend reason; do not substitute a different artifact

auxiliary_artifacts.purpose: Keep link and low-compressibility behavior separate from the named tensor contract.

consumer_outputs.interpretation: A matching hash proves byte preservation for this fixture and consumer; it says nothing about speech, vision or language quality.

plain.description: transport the original bytes through the bounded two-stage path

coded.description: transport coded ranges, decode and place into a plaintext buffer

http_range.description: exercise range reads when the source advertises and honors them

http_no_range.description: exercise the existing fallback when the source returns a full response

sealed.description: exercise local authenticated private distribution only when the existing crypto backend is available
sealed.compatibility: transport/integrity-only; no policy or customer claim

measurement_rules.cache: Use cache=off for loader arms; report whether a host cold read was actually controllable.
measurement_rules.resource_scope: Bounded current-process RSS/PSS/HWM sampling; child pages, allocator-specific, device and energy counters remain explicit UNMEASURED when unavailable.
measurement_rules.time_events: All readiness events use one time.monotonic_ns origin. Missing consumer events are null, not zero.
measurement_rules.parallelism: The campaign compares one and two fetch workers under one shared aggregate cap; extra threads must not be read as extra link capacity.
measurement_rules.failure: Induced failures remain in results.jsonl and errors/; detection rows carry the engineering verdict.
measurement_rules.strategic_evidence: Local fixtures establish mechanism behavior. Real device, host, customer, cost and authenticated-store evidence is reported unavailable unless supplied.
